spots.name: Taipei 101 Observatory
spots.desc: A 360° night view over the Taipei Basin, reached in just 37 seconds by a world-class high-speed elevator.

spots.name: Jiufen Old Street & A-Mei Teahouse
spots.desc: The inspiration behind Miyazaki's Spirited Away: red-lantern stone steps and taro-ball mountain-town tea.

spots.name: National Palace Museum
spots.desc: Home to nearly 700,000 imperial treasures of Chinese dynasties, including the famed Jadeite Cabbage.

spots.name: Taroko Gorge Swallow Grotto, Hualien
spots.desc: The Liwu River carving thousand-meter marble cliffs over millions of years—a world-class geological wonder.

spots.name: Shuishe Pier, Sun Moon Lake, Nantou
spots.desc: Named by CNN among the world's ten most beautiful bike paths; the morning lake is picture-perfect.

spots.name: Alishan Zhushan Sunrise, Chiayi
spots.desc: Ride the century-old mountain train and greet the golden sunrise amid a churning sea of clouds.

spots.name: Chimei Museum, Tainan
spots.desc: Greek Apollo Fountain and a baroque white palace housing a premium violin collection.

spots.name: Pier-2 Art Center & Great Harbor Bridge, Kaohsiung
spots.desc: A harbor warehouse turned creative district, anchored by Taiwan's first rotating Great Harbor Bridge.

spots.name: Baisha Bay & Eluanbi, Kenting, Pingtung
spots.desc: A tropical azure bay and pure-white coral beach, guarded by Taiwan's southernmost white lighthouse.

spots.name: Qingjing Farm Green Green Grassland, Nantou
spots.desc: Rolling emerald alpine grasslands, a sheep-shearing show, and the majestic Central Mountain Range.

spots.name: Gaomei Wetland Sunset & Windmills, Taichung
spots.desc: Hailed as Taiwan's Mirror of the Sky! The mudflats reflect the vast sunset glow in a perfectly romantic scene.

spots.name: Lanyang Museum, Yilan
spots.desc: A geometric cuesta-style building blending into the Northeast Coast, an eco-cultural hall by Wushi Harbor.

spots.name: Sanxiantai Eight-Arched Bridge, Taitung
spots.desc: A dragon-like eight-arched red bridge spanning the Pacific, greeting Taiwan's first rays of dawn.

spots.name: Yehliu Geopark Queen's Head, New Taipei
spots.desc: A mushroom rock sculpted by millennia of waves and weathering, resembling the regal profile of a queen.

spots.name: Anping Fort & Tree House, Tainan
spots.desc: Remnants of Dutch-era Fort Zeelandia, where a century-old banyan and red-brick warehouses intertwine.

spots.name: Qimei Double-Heart Stone Weir, Penghu
spots.desc: Two interlocking heart-shaped stone weirs in crystal-blue water—ancestral fishing wisdom and a romantic legend.

spots.name: Green Island Zhaori Undersea Hot Spring
spots.desc: One of only three undersea saltwater hot springs in the world; listen to the tide and watch the sunrise at dawn.

spots.name: Deyue Tower & Shuitou Village, Kinmen
spots.desc: Traditional Minnan courtyards blending with Southeast Asian overseas-Chinese mansions, rich with defensive tower history.

spots.name: Smangus, Hsinchu
spots.desc: A pristine Atayal village deep in the mountains, where towering millennia-old cypress trees cleanse body and soul.

spots.name: Beitou Thermal Valley Hot Springs, Taipei
spots.desc: Green-sulfur geothermal steam drifting like a fairyland, with a stunning Anglo-Japanese eclectic red-brick bathhouse.

charter.name: Jiufen Old Street · Shifen Sky Lantern · Yehliu Geopark Classic Day Charter
charter.desc: Northern Taiwan's most popular route! A direct charter through the golden mountain town and Shifen Waterfall, releasing sky lanterns for blessings.

charter.name: Taroko National Park & Qingshui Cliff Charter, Hualien
charter.desc: A local veteran driver guides you through Swallow Grotto, Tunnel of Nine Turns, Baiyang Waterfall Cave, and azure Qingshui Cliff.

charter.name: Alishan Forest Sunrise & Fenqihu Sea of Clouds Charter
charter.desc: Skip the pre-dawn train-ticket scramble—a charter takes you straight to Zhushan sunrise, the giant tree trail, and Fenqihu lunchboxes.

charter.name: Sun Moon Lake & Qingjing Skywalk Charter, Nantou
charter.desc: Two central-Taiwan icons in one day! Cycle at Shuishe Pier and watch the sheep show at Qingjing's Green Green Grassland.

charter.name: Kenting National Park & Hengchun Peninsula Sea View Charter Day Tour
charter.desc: Sail Rock, Eluanbi Lighthouse, Longpan Park cliffs, and Baisha Bay—a complete tour of southern sunshine and sea breeze.

charter.name: Jiaoxi Hot Springs & Matcha Mountain Trail Charter, Yilan
charter.desc: Summit the emerald Matcha Mountain for views over the Lanyang Plain, then head down to Jiaoxi for a soothing natural hot spring.

charter.name: Anping Fort & Guohua Street Food & Chihkan Tower Charter, Tainan
charter.desc: A comfortable charter through Tainan's ancient lanes to feast on beef soup and eel noodles, sparing you the hot walks.

charter.name: Cijin Rainbow Church · Pier-2 Art Center · Fo Guang Shan Charter, Kaohsiung
charter.desc: A port city's sea-and-land treat! Visit Fo Guang Shan's solemn Buddha, then watch the romantic sunset at Sizihwan.

charter.name: Chishang Brown Avenue & Sanxiantai Bridge Charter, Taitung
charter.desc: Cruise the East Rift Valley's golden rice fields and Takeshi Kaneshiro Tree, then cross the Coastal Range for the Pacific eight-arch bridge.

charter.name: Beitou Hot Springs & Yangmingshan Qixinggang Xiaoyoukeng Charter, Taipei
charter.desc: A relaxing day in Taipei's backyard! Watch Xiaoyoukeng's geothermal steam and stroll Qingtiangang's buffalo grasslands.

events.name: Megaport Festival
events.date: Grand opening in late March each year
events.tag: Taiwan's Largest Harbor Indie Music Festival
events.desc: Ten stages spanning both sides of Kaohsiung Harbor, with the Great Harbor Bridge rotation, rock bands, and star-studded performances.
events.price: 每年 3 月底盛大登場

events.name: Taiwan International Balloon Fiesta
events.tag: Sky-High Feast for a Million Visitors
events.desc: Distinctive giant balloons rise over the Luye grassland, with night light shows and a stunning drone display.

events.name: New Taipei Christmasland
events.loc: New Taipei Civic Plaza & Banqiao Station
events.desc: Taiwan's largest 3D projection mapping, a sparkling star-lit skywalk, and a traditional German Christmas market—a winter romance.
events.city: New Taipei Civic Plaza & Banqiao Station
events.price: 每年 11 月至翌年 1 月

events.name: Dajia Mazu Pilgrimage, Taichung
events.loc: Dajia Jenn Lann Temple to Fengtian Temple
events.date: Third lunar month each year (9 days 8 nights)
events.tag: One of the World's Three Great Religious Events (UNESCO)
events.desc: A 340-kilometer journey across four counties, with millions of devout followers on foot—the most moving display of Taiwanese warmth.
events.city: Dajia Jenn Lann Temple to Fengtian Temple

events.name: Gongliao International Ocean Music Festival
events.desc: An original-music carnival on golden sands—the hallowed beach festival where countless Taiwanese bands rose to fame.

events.name: Taipei Game Show (TpGS)
events.desc: Hands-on demos of unreleased titles from top global game studios, esports finals, and an indie games zone.

events.name: Yanshui Beehive Fireworks Festival, Tainan
events.date: Lantern Festival each year (14th–15th of the first lunar month)
events.tag: Top 10 Most Passionate Festivals in the World
events.desc: Millions of beehive firecrackers burst in unison; armored with a full-face helmet, experience the thrilling ritual to ward off evil and welcome fortune.
events.price: 每年元宵節 (正月十四至十五)

events.name: Chiayi International Band Festival
events.desc: Over 50 top marching bands from home and abroad parade through Chiayi's streets, filling the city with music.

events.name: Creative Expo Taiwan
events.tag: Asia's Largest Cultural Creative IP Expo
events.desc: Gathering Taiwan's original illustration, creative design, handmade crafts, independent designers, and local culture exhibitions.

events.name: Pingxi International Sky Lantern Festival
events.desc: Thousands of wish-bearing sky lanterns rise together into the night, like a galaxy of stars descending to earth.

rainy.name: Tainan | Chimei Museum
rainy.indoor: Pure White Baroque Palace · Premium Violins & Western Art
rainy.desc: Taiwan's richest private museum! The Apollo fountain, Rodin's Thinker, and the world's largest violin collection—half a day isn't enough even on a rainy day.

rainy.name: Taipei | National Palace Museum
rainy.indoor: One of the World's Four Great Museums · 700K Imperial Treasures
rainy.desc: While storms rage outside, enjoy the quiet warmth within—the Jadeite Cabbage, Meat-Shaped Stone, Mao Gong Ding, and the Complete Library of the Four Treasuries.

rainy.name: Taoyuan | Xpark Urban Aquarium
rainy.indoor: Yokohama Hakkeijima's First Overseas Branch · Healing Jellyfish Tank
rainy.desc: A 5-minute walk from Taoyuan HSR Station! A light-and-music immersive aquarium where penguins walk overhead and silver fish school in a huge tank.

rainy.name: Taipei | Taipei 101 Observatory & Indoor Mall
rainy.indoor: Indoor Sky View of Misty Cloud Sea · Wind Damper Exhibit
rainy.desc: Taipei 101 has a special charm on rainy days! Watch the clouds churn outside like a sky fairyland, and see the world's largest 660-ton wind damper up close.

rainy.name: Taichung | National Taichung Theater
rainy.indoor: Toyo Ito Curved-Wall Aesthetic · Beamless Architectural Marvel
rainy.desc: Hailed by international media as one of the world's nine new landmarks! Step into the cave-like curved-wall space to shop, sip coffee, and view art.

rainy.name: Yilan | Lanyang Museum
rainy.indoor: Cuesta Geometric Glass Building · Yilan's Geology History
rainy.desc: While rain falls over the Lanyang Plain outside, light pours through the museum's tilted glass—an introduction to Yilan's mountains, plains, and seas.

rainy.name: Keelung | National Museum of Marine Science & Technology
rainy.indoor: Converted from a Power Plant · Giant Marine Science Museum
rainy.desc: Keelung's best indoor spot for rainy days! An interactive deep-sea submarine, a touch pool, and an IMAX ocean theater.

rainy.name: Taipei | Taipei Fine Arts Museum
rainy.indoor: White Square Tube Modern Aesthetic · Serene Contemporary Art
rainy.desc: A white light-filled atrium with cutting-edge contemporary art, plus a bookstore and elegant café—perfect for a solo rainy-day recharge.

rainy.name: Kaohsiung | Fine Arts Museum & Neiwei Arts Center
rainy.indoor: Pure White Curved Hill Building · Cinema & Light Meals
rainy.desc: Direct light-rail access to Neiwei! Wander the open white art hall, enjoy sound experiments and local small-farm coffee in total ease.

rainy.name: Taichung | National Museum of Natural Science
rainy.indoor: Giant T-Rex Hall · Space Theater & Greenhouse
rainy.desc: A classic for all ages! A lifelike roaring animatronic T-Rex, a giant 3D theater, and a rainforest glasshouse make for a full day indoors.

cafe.name: Simple Kaffa Flagship Store
cafe.feature: Founded by WBC champion Wu Tse-lin, a forest-style timber courtyard serving the must-order wrinkled cake and pour-overs.

cafe.name: RUFOUS COFFEE ROASTERS
cafe.feature: A legendary Taipei old-house roaster! An amber vintage wooden bar, with layered espresso and lightly acidic Yirgacheffe.

cafe.name: Fika Fika Cafe
cafe.feature: Nordic Cup roasting champion! Light-roast bright acidity in a pure-white minimalist space with great light for afternoon reading.

cafe.name: CAFE!N Minquan Flagship
cafe.feature: A giant exclamation-mark landmark and a two-story white glass facade, with champion black coffee and crispy bread—highly photogenic.

cafe.name: Heritage Bakery & Cafe
cafe.feature: Taipei's cinnamon-roll and red-guava chiffon champion! A high-ceilinged red-brick house pairing pour-over coffee with American baking.

cafe.name: Coffee Stopover
cafe.feature: An alleyway artisanal roasting temple! Five brewing methods and dozens of roast levels—a must-visit for coffee lovers.

cafe.name: mezamashikohi
cafe.feature: A fair-faced concrete courtyard with greenery, morning light through floor-to-ceiling windows, handmade toast, and delicate single-origin coffee.

cafe.name: StableNice BLDG. Timber Heritage House
cafe.feature: A converted old Tainan printing house! Combining specialty coffee, curated goods, and a semi-open courtyard with warm old brick and timber.

cafe.name: OH! Cafe
cafe.feature: Founded by world roasting champion Lai Yu-Chuan! Golden beans by Sizihwan's sea breeze, with aromatic iced-drip coffee.

cafe.name: Showa Romantic Ice Parlor Cafe & Bar
cafe.feature: Vintage sofas and Showa pudding in an old house! At night, whiskey cold brew and craft cocktails create a warm, tipsy romance.

cafe.name: Instil Coffee Dimension
cafe.feature: An immersive basement black-industrial space focused on espresso extraction curves and nitro cold brew, with a strong tech vibe.

cafe.name: AKA café (Dadaocheng Heritage House)
cafe.feature: A quiet heritage house on Dihua Street with handmade square caramel pudding and black coffee—perfect for a solo escape.

cafe.name: Fu Coffee Mansion
cafe.feature: Red velvet chairs, stained-glass pendants, and old vinyl records—step back to Japan's Taisho-Showa era over siphon coffee.

cafe.name: Good Cho's Xinyi
cafe.feature: 44 South Village's wooden-windowed quarters serve handmade bagels from local ingredients, paired with oat lattes facing Taipei 101.

cafe.name: MKCR Mountain Kids Coffee
cafe.tag: Front-Row Window View of Beimen Heritage
cafe.feature: Facing the national heritage Beimen! A pure-white minimalist two-story café; sip an oat latte by the window overlooking the historic gate.

cafe.name: Mori/CASA Coffee Salon
cafe.tag: Kaikado Century Tea Caddy from Kyoto
cafe.feature: Classic Danish chairs and Kaikado's century-old copper canisters from Kyoto—a serene wabi-sabi space for premium pour-over.

cafe.name: Coffee Sind
cafe.feature: A greenhouse in a Xinsheng South Road lane! A tiny takeout bar surrounded by succulents, famous for its Chihkan sugar latte and pour-over.

cafe.name: Single Origin espresso & roast
cafe.feature: A calm café tucked in an East District lane, rejecting commercial blends to explore the pure flavors of multiple origins.

cafe.name: Muzha Louisa Roasting Flagship
cafe.feature: A triple-height industrial roasting flagship with outlets everywhere and abundant light—a favorite base for remote workers.

cafe.name: Coffee Lover's Planet
cafe.feature: A soaring circular bar at SOGO Dunhua! Experience up to seven brewing methods, from French press to siphon, pour-over, and cold brew.

walk.name: Taipei Chifeng Street | Blacksmith Street Turned Indie Shops & Coffee Lanes
walk.desc: Once an auto-parts street, now full of vintage shops, indie bookstores, Showa coffee houses, and handmade jewelry—surprises in every lane.

walk.name: Dadaocheng Dihua Street | Wander Century-Old Baroque Mansions & Dried Goods Aromas
walk.desc: Old Taipei's bustling port, where herbal, tea, and fabric scents mingle; visit traditional bakeries and the old streets of painter Kuo Hsueh-hu.

walk.name: Tainan Shennong Street | Red Lanterns & Late-Night Glow Under Century-Old Wooden Shophouses
walk.desc: The busiest old street of the Five Canals' heyday, with wooden houses hanging hand-painted red lanterns—a walk through Qing-era Tainan.

walk.name: Taichung Audit Village | Weekend Youth Creative Market in Reborn Provincial Quarters
walk.desc: Two-story ochre military-village dorms that on weekends host Taiwan's hottest handmade desserts, vinyl, vintage cameras, and creative stalls.

walk.name: Kaohsiung Yancheng Kujiang Market | Old Port Import Goods & Japanese Wooden House Lanes
walk.desc: Kaohsiung's trendiest district from the U.S.-aid era, hiding old tailor shops, Grandma's Ice, glass-noodle king, and hip izakayas.

walk.name: Taipei Qingtian Street | Stroll Showa Japanese Black-Tile Dorms & Tree-Lined Avenues
walk.desc: Taipei's quietest cultural oasis—old Japanese dorms under camphor trees, Granary No. 1, and Qingtian 76 mansion, with soothing tea aromas.

walk.name: Chiayi Hinoki Village | Stroll Taiwan's Largest Japanese Cypress Residence Complex
walk.desc: The former Alishan forestry officials' quarters, preserving 29 wooden Japanese black-tile houses filled with the fragrance of cypress.

walk.name: Hsinchu Hukou Old Street | Century-Old Baroque Arcade & Hakka Rice Delicacies
walk.desc: A perfectly symmetrical 300-meter red-brick facade, with Hakka niuwenshui, Hakka ground tea, and a century-old Catholic church.

walk.name: Yilan Zhongxing Cultural Park | Giant Chimney & Decaying Industrial Aesthetic of the Old Paper Mill
walk.desc: Converted from Taiwan's largest paper mill! Giant boiler chimneys and timber warehouses turned into pottery, metalwork, and dyeing studios.

walk.name: New Taipei Tamsui Chongjian Street | Step-Stone Lanes of the Real Old Tamsui
walk.desc: Tamsui's true original old street! Wander stone-step paths, herb houses, and the former home of artist Kinoshita Seiga, overlooking the sunset.

walk.name: Keelung Weituohang District | American Import Memories & Hidden Cafés in Narrow Lanes
walk.desc: Once a trading ground for foreign sailors in Keelung Harbor's heyday, now a hub of late-night craft beer bars, pour-over cafés, and old record shops.

walk.name: Hualien Gouzaiwei Old Mansions | Creative Cluster in a Checkerboard Lane Slow-City Walk
walk.desc: A former bustling red-light district now renovated into indie bookshops, used-record stores, and roasters, with a relaxed sea-breeze pace.

walk.name: Taitung Tiehua Music Village | Clear Indigenous Voices Under a Sea of Painted Balloon Lanterns
walk.desc: Grassy railway warehouses with hundreds of painted balloon lanterns lighting the night, as you sit on the grass to hear indigenous singers.

walk.name: Taipei Treasure Hill Artist Village | Hillside Historic Settlement & Artist Residency
walk.desc: A terraced hillside historic settlement by the Xindian River; wander its maze of narrow lanes to visit resident artists' studios.

walk.name: Taipei 44 South Village | Taipei's First Military Village Meets Modern Xinyi Skyscrapers
walk.desc: Behind a green grassy slope rises Taipei 101, its skyscraper a striking contrast to the old village tile roofs and weekend market.

walk.name: Taichung Green Ray Fantasia | 12 Water-Works Dorm Houses of an Aesthetic Living Circle
walk.desc: A model of old-house revival on Zhongxing Lane 1, with a second-floor green skywalk linking fragrance, leather, and plant cafés.

walk.name: Tainan Snail Alley | Follow Author Yeh Shih-tao Through Old Tainan's Slow City
walk.desc: A lovely place to dream, work, fall in love, marry, and live leisurely. Follow the snail murals through the narrow lanes.

walk.name: Lukang Guihua Lane | Traditional Red-Brick Lanes & Japanese Art Village Wood Houses
walk.desc: The Lane of Nine Turns blocks wind and thieves, the Half Well shows neighborly care; visit Guihua Lane Art Village for Lukang's master woodcarvers and pewter artisans.

walk.name: Pingtung Shengli Star Village | Taiwan's Largest General's Quarters Reborn as a Creative Park
walk.desc: A Japanese-era army flight commander's residence with a spacious green courtyard, now home to qipao experiences, indie bookshops, and local food.

walk.name: Penghu Erkan Village | Century-Old Minnan Coral-Stone Courtyards & Aromatic Almond Tea
walk.desc: Taiwan's first preserved traditional settlement, with basalt and coral-stone houses—don't miss the hand-ground almond tea.

family.name: Taipei Zoo (Muzha Zoo)
family.tag: Asia's Largest Zoo · Family Favorite
family.desc: Asia's largest zoo! Explore the giant panda, penguin, African, and rainforest zones, and ride the park train for endless fun.

family.name: National Museum of Marine Biology (Pingtung Aquarium)
family.tag: World-Class Giant Aquarium · Sleepover at the Aquarium
family.desc: Walk the 84-meter underwater tunnel, admire graceful belugas and a giant kelp forest, and sleep over at the penguin hall—a dream adventure for kids.

family.name: National Museum of Natural Science (Taichung)
family.tag: Animatronic T-Rex Dinosaur Hall · 3D Space Theater
family.desc: A popular roaring animatronic T-Rex, an immersive space theater, and a rainforest greenhouse—fun science exploration.

family.name: Taipei Children's Amusement Park
family.tag: Urban Fairy-Tale Park · Ferris Wheel & Carousel
family.desc: Finding Nemo and Robocar Poli Ferris wheels, a monorail, bumper cars, and a pirate ship—an affordable joyland right by the MRT.

family.name: Leofoo Village Theme Park
family.tag: Wildlife Kingdom · Thrilling Extreme Rides
family.desc: Ride the steam train to see rhinos and giraffes up close, and brave the coasters and water rides for a summer blast.

family.name: Farglory Ocean Park, Hualien
family.tag: Unbeatable Pacific Views · Dolphin & Sea Lion Carnival
family.desc: Perched on a hill with unbeatable East Coast sea views! Watch dolphins leap, sea lion shows, a crystal castle fantasy show, and a cable car.

family.name: Lihpao Land (Discovery World), Taichung
family.tag: Taiwan's Largest Sky Dream Ferris Wheel · Race Track
family.desc: Taiwan's largest Sky Dream Ferris wheel and the world's only 'Gravity Max' coaster, plus outlet shopping and an international race track.

family.name: Janfusun Fancyworld, Yunlin
family.tag: Ferris Wheel Dome · Thrilling Sky Tower
family.desc: A classic central-Taiwan theme park! A 100-meter rainbow Ferris wheel, the G5 dive coaster, and family-friendly rides.

family.name: E-DA Theme Park, Kaohsiung
family.tag: Greek Aegean Setting · Asia's Largest Indoor Park
family.desc: A romantic white Santorini setting with Taiwan's largest indoor theme park—fun in any weather.

family.name: National Museum of Marine Science & Technology (Keelung)
family.tag: Chaojing Smart Aquarium · Immersive Interactive
family.desc: A marine hall converted from an old power plant! With a giant slide, the Chaojing Smart Aquarium, and a sea turtle rehabilitation pool.

family.name: National Center for Traditional Arts, Yilan
family.tag: Nostalgic Old Street Toys · Hands-On DIY
family.desc: Step into a folk-art red-brick street to try candied haws, dough figurines, indigo dyeing, and pottery, and enjoy street parades.

family.name: New Taipei Metropolitan Park (Xionghousen)
family.tag: Taiwan's Largest Embankment Slide · 31 Inclusive Play Structures
family.desc: Taiwan's wildest free outdoor park! Native-animal themed, with 31 roller slides and over 100 inclusive play structures, all free.

family.name: Window on China Theme Park, Taoyuan
family.tag: World Miniature Architecture · Toddler-Friendly Park
family.desc: Scaled-down world landmarks, miniature Taiwan railways, and gentle rides designed for young children.

family.name: Flying Cow Ranch, Miaoli
family.tag: Alpine Grassland · Feed & Milk Cows, Camp
family.desc: A vast Switzerland-like highland grassland! Kids feed and milk calves, then enjoy pure, creamy milk pudding.

family.name: Three Little Pigs Farm, Chiayi
family.tag: Giant Pink Pig Display · Feed Capybaras Up Close
family.desc: Fairy-tale giant mushroom and Three Little Pigs houses, with meerkats, capybaras, alpacas, mini horses, and a giant slide.

family.name: Kaohsiung Shoushan Zoo
family.tag: Skywalk · Water Plaza Capybara Hill
family.desc: Recently renovated! Stroll the elevated green walkway to view animals, and visit capybara and black bear habitats up close.

family.name: Changmei Grandma Farm, Yilan
family.tag: Adorable Capybaras in Hot Springs · Japanese Garden Kimono
family.desc: Taiwan's hottest adorable-animal farm! Wear a yukata to feed sheep, kangaroos, and capybaras, then enjoy handmade scallion pancakes.

family.name: Baiguoshan Adventure Park, Changhua
family.tag: Taiwan's Jurassic Park · Life-Size Animatronic Dinosaurs
family.desc: Taiwan's largest dinosaur theme park! Over 40 roaring animatronic giants, plus dinosaur coasters and spinning rides.

family.name: Tainan Public Library New Main Branch (Kids' Island)
family.tag: Most Beautiful Forest Library · Kids' Sensory Room
family.desc: Winner of multiple architecture awards! A huge kids' exploration zone, 3D picture-book wall, and screening room in the basement, plus an outdoor water playground.

family.name: Tainan Zuozhen Fossil Park
family.tag: Taiwan's Largest Fossil Museum · Ancient Mammoths
family.desc: Taiwan's only fossil-themed museum! Displaying mammoths, Chinese rhinos, and saber-toothed elephants from millions of years ago.

mall.name: Taipei 101 Mall
mall.tag: International Luxury Flagship · Urban Skyscraper Core
mall.desc: Gathering top global luxury flagships, a soaring atrium, and Michelin-starred restaurants, with a basement food court of must-buy souvenirs.

mall.name: Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Taipei Xinyi (A4/A8/A9/A11)
mall.tag: Taiwan's Top Department Store Cluster · Skybridge Shopping
mall.desc: Four skybridge-connected pavilions of fashion, family fun, fine dining, and pop-ups—the unbeatable heart of Xinyi District.
mall.features: Xiangti Boulevard Street Performers · Festival Market

mall.name: Far Eastern SOGO Taipei Fuxing (BR4)
mall.tag: Zhongxiao Fuxing Dual-MRT Hub · International Luxury Palace
mall.desc: Directly at Zhongxiao Fuxing MRT! International luxury brands, Japanese garden restaurants, a premium supermarket, and Taiwan's highest-performing counters.
mall.features: Soaring Atrium Natural Light · Premium VIP Lounge

mall.name: Top City, Taichung
mall.tag: Taichung 7th Redevelopment Landmark · Venice Canal Cinemas
